description.narrative: This activity aims to assist DPWH in building up its capacity for results monitoring, and defining and testing an organizational arrangement that can be responsive for agency-wide results monitoring, towards helping DPWH improve its performance as a major infrastructure agency in the Philippines. DPWH will be guided toward measuring and reporting performance in terms of service provided to road-users and other clients and other indicators of effectiveness and efficiency, on top of the current system of quantitative reporting on inputs (pesos and implementation periods) and outputs (kilometers of roads and lineal meters of bridges). A starting point for engagement with DPWH will be the NRIMP2 Results Framework, which has been prepared and agreed upon as part of the project appraisal document. However, to date DPWH has encountered difficulties in preparing the baseline data and has requested technical assistance especially at the early stage of results monitoring for the project. This activity will then expand the application of the principles of results monitoring to DPWH's regular planning activities, implementation of works, and to its annual reporting of accomplishments. Proposed IDF Components/Activities (including Expected Outcome: 1. Course trainings on basic and advanced results monitoring for key DPWH (central and field offices) and NRIM-PMO staffs. Training should also aim to identify potential results monitoring experts within the agency, who can continue the in-house capacity-building program. 2. Strategic workshops with selected officials and technical staff on incorporating results monitoring as a key strategy in DPWH planning and monitoring activities, and in defining an organizational arrangement for results monitoring 3. Coaching on actual application of results monitoring principles in NRIMP2 results framework and planning, budgeting and other activities of the DPWH quantitative reporting on inputs (pesos and implementation periods) and outputs (kilometers of roads and lineal meters of bridges).
